I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Artificial Intelligence and
Data Engineering at Istanbul Technical University. I work on artificial neural
networks, (bio)medical image analysis, and computer vision.

I decided to use this site as a platform for sharing my research findings and experiments. 
I will mostly write up experiments that are worth reporting: controlled measurements, negative results, and the occasional thing that turned out to be simpler than it looked. The posts are short by design.
Each one answers four questions — what is the problem, what is already known,
what I ran, and what did not work.

Publications are on
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=hoUlZL4AAAAJ&hl=en)
and [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8649-6013); my department page is at
[ITU Akademi](https://akademi.itu.edu.tr/tekfb/Faik-Boray-Tek). More on the
[about](about.qmd) and [CV](cv.qmd) pages.
